solution_designs.state_model: Search with previous/current, unlink, then optional recycle.
representation: object model does not invent free-list state
preconditions: Occurrence rule, absence assumption and recycling contract are known.
postconditions: Array slots remain a complete live/free partition; object list is acyclic and null-terminated.
All exact source return/output obligations remain part-specific.
invariants: Search and return behaviour match one source contract.
Before each test, previous is null for head or directly precedes current; prefix contains no match.
Failure leaves every link and pointer unchanged.
All surviving live nodes retain order and current becomes unreachable from head.
Removed node is free exactly once and every old free node remains reachable.
Array slots remain a complete live/free partition; object list is acyclic and null-terminated.
mutation_and_preservation_rules: No mutation on a guarded failure path.
Every successful mutation restores the representation invariant before return.
Physical stale values are not live unless reachable under metadata/links.
failure_paths: Previous is null or head still reaches the removed node.
The live suffix is lost or linked into the free chain.
It dereferences null or changes the source interface.
